knowledge_cards.claim: The reported tau_init about 0.8 region is exploratory informal-listening evidence, not a controlled perceptual threshold.
Warm-initialization FAD uses transfer guidance 30 versus reference guidance 7, making numeric thresholds setup-specific.
Pitch-set Jaccard omits note order, timing, duration, dynamics and stereo and cannot protect groove or transients.
Only two timbre-transfer directions receive quantitative sweeps; MIDI-to-real and enhancement are qualitative examples.
Noise injection can worsen pitch faithfulness through hallucination while FAD remains similar, requiring paired multi-seed review.
Reported percussive suppression failure blocks transfer to drum cleanup or separation claims.
Companion examples without code, model revision, seed manifest and listener protocol support qualitative inspection only.
Plate-challenge scientific estimation requires unnormalized NPZ input; normalized WAV previews discard amplitude information.
Public availability without an explicit licence is not rights clearance for ingestion or redistribution.
